scope: Headless resource/constant evaluation diagnostic, not graphical or performance qualification
interpretation: Runtime resource and attached-material reads track the mutation; frozen constant/property expression and statistics do not. Compiler folding is an inference, not compiler-source proof. V1 remains rejected and its native attachment is not retroactively established.
raw_log_custody: Original process.log remains local diagnostic evidence; its hash is retained here. Raw process logs are not committed under repository policy.
